name: @ghilteras/opencode-auto-bg
description: Transparent automatic backgrounding for OpenCode subagents — no API changes, no new tools. Hooks into session.created to background architect's children, plus a wake safety net for the ~3% of cases where native wake fails, and a state-based TODO-sync nudge for the architect session.
author: Angelo Pantano <ghilteras@protonmail.com>
